# ClientHellos captured from real TLS clients on loopback, with the JA4 that
# Wireshark 4.6.9 computes for each (tshark -T fields -e tls.handshake.ja4,
# the hello wrapped in a TCP packet to port 443 by text2pcap).
# Fields: name, JA4 from tshark, the TLS records that carry the hello (hex).
# openssl41-frag512 is one hello split over four handshake records; the
# chrome hellos carry GREASE values and extensions in random order.
